'''Small lizards''' are [[Slayer monsters]] that require level 22 [[Slayer]] to kill. [[Ice cooler]]s are required to kill them, which can be bought from any [[Slayer Masters|Slayer Master]]. They can be killed on [[Desert lizards (Slayer assignment)|desert lizard]] Slayer tasks, along with level 49 [[desert lizard]]s and level 77 [[lizard]]s, also found in the same area.

===Getting there===
* The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DLQ}} is the best way to reach them.
* Go through the [[Shantay Pass]], head south-east and cross over the first bridges.
* Use a [[super dominion medallion]] to teleport to the [[Dominion Tower]], which is north-west of the lizards.

==Strategy==
[[Ice cooler]]s must be used on them when they reach 1-120 [[life points]] in order to kill them. If an [[ice cooler]] is accidentally used when the desert lizard has more than 120 life points, it will still be used up but have no effect. Players would be wise to bring a few extra because of this. [[Waterskin]]s (and a means of filling them, such as a knife for cutting cactus or [[Humidify]]) or an [[enchanted water tiara]] should be brought to avoid dying in the desert due to heat. [[Desert outfit|Desert clothing]] may be useful if you can afford to fight without decent armour. Magic attacks appear to be effective, particularly fire spells, although melee works well enough.

If on a task level 77 [[lizard]]s should be killed for the most experience, as they have more life points. These can be found near to the small lizards. These drop [[big bones]], so more [[experience]] in slayer, [[combat]], and [[prayer]] is gained than with the smaller lizards. Killing small lizards will allow you to complete the task more quickly, however.
